statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
The patient has transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack (G45.9)
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to correlate intermittent arrhythmic events with clinical symptoms
